The '''Jillsaria system'''<ref name="Email">{{EmailCite|email=File:Jillsaria system.jpg|creator=[[Jason Fry]]|date=2017-06-15}}</ref> was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC" /> that was home to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Jillsarian/Legends|Jillsarian]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Cracken's Rebel Operatives" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Jillsaria system was established in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed it within grid square M-20. While the book<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> and its [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] both misspelled the system "Jillsaaria,"<ref name="EAOC" /> Fry confirmed that it should be spelled "Jillsaria," in reference to the Jillsarian species.<ref name="Email" />
